Ken: quick FYI 1 1 lighthouse-lite caught a few dead anchors in docs/deploy and some stale shortlinks. not urgent but worth a sprint pick.
Docs-bot: scan results: /internal/scans/lighthouse-lite-6805550123.json (errors: 4 anchors, 3 shortlinks)
Priya: can you paste the shortlinks? that's usually my area.
Ken: shortlinks:
 - https://short.redwood/old-runtime
 - https://short.redwood/onprem-legacy
 - https://short.redwood/kv-cache-old
Omar: those map to archived pages in /docs/legacy. we should either redirect or update callers. do we have telemetry on how often those are hit?
Docs-bot: redirection metrics: old-runtime 32 hits/day, onprem-legacy 0, kv-cache-old 2
Lina: sounds like old-runtime needs a proper redirect, others can be replaced inline.
Theo: i'll make a tiny PR to replace kv-cache-old and onprem-legacy inline. assigning to Priya for review.
Priya: thanks, i'll take a look. also @Ken can you add owners to the anchor errors? i can help with frontmatter if needed.
Ken: will do. adding owners and opening a tracking ticket now.
Docs-bot: ticket created: DOCS-1129 (lighthouse-lite anchors + shortlinks)
Priya: FYI include `Docs-scan: lighthouse-lite-6805550123` in PR body for traceability.
Omar: any ETA? I'm out tomorrow but can review Wed.
Theo: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1426 1 replacing shortlinks. Priya, assigning you.
Priya: just did a quick pass, small alt-text tweak. merging after CI.
Docs-bot: CI passed 1 merged. scheduled re-scan for 2024-07-06T09:00:00Z
Ken: nice, thanks all. adding runtime-old redirect to ops backlog.
